analyses.question: Count clean sheets match by match
analyses.approach: Fixture-level goals conceded = 0; reconcile league rounds
analyses.finding: 34-match recount: 24 clean sheets (70.6%), including 13 goalless 0-0 draws; counts match official GFA season statistics.
analyses.peer_check: Match totals reconcile to RSSSF final table; GFA season report confirms 24 clean sheets
analyses.limitations: Match scores only; no tactical or chance-quality evidence; owner approval still required

analyses.question: Compare goals scored, draws and league finish
analyses.approach: Check team results and recompute points
analyses.finding: 13 W,15 D,6 L,25 GF,15 GA,54 points,3rd; Medeama 17 W,11 D,6 L,62 points: four additional wins in place of draws account for eight-point gap.
analyses.peer_check: RSSSF final standings reconciled; Ghana FA reports Hearts 3rd, Medeama champions
analyses.limitations: Descriptive points arithmetic only; cannot infer causal football tactics

analyses.question: How many Hearts clean sheets were 0-0 draws?
analyses.approach: Count opponent_goals=0 and hearts_goals=0 from 34 matches
analyses.finding: 13 of 24 clean sheets (54.2%) were goalless draws, making 13 of 15 draws scoreless (86.7%).
analyses.peer_check: Validated against 34 match scores and final table
analyses.limitations: Match-result descriptive analysis; not an explanation of tactics

evidence.claim: Hearts of Oak recorded 24 clean sheets
evidence.qualification: Team clean sheets, not individual goalkeeper count; 34 match results agree with Ghana FA summary

evidence.claim: Hearts of Oak finished third in the league
evidence.qualification: Match-by-match points reconcile to final table; owner approval still required

evidence.claim: Hearts drew 13 games 0-0 in the 2025/26 league season
evidence.qualification: Computed from complete 34-game transcription, not an official GFA stat; owner spot-check required

evidence.claim: Hearts and Medeama both lost six matches; Medeama had four more wins, four fewer draws and eight more points
evidence.qualification: League table comparison; descriptive arithmetic, not a causal claim
